Name: D_0
dialogue: 2,000 people managed to find and apply for this measly $15-per-hour job. Have mercy.

Name: D_1
dialogue: I really should have made Nyra a VTuber and prayed the Yourtube algorithm blessed me if I have to constantly compete with thousands of people every day.

Name: D_2
dialogue: It shows how crap this country is becoming if a job like this is so competitive. But it's not like getting this job would have made a difference anyway.

Name: D_4
dialogue: It's not like I can earn the amount of $500 in three days with this garbage. I just... I can't afford to stay here anymore.

Name: D_5
dialogue: But where can I go? Is there any city or place on Earth that isn't struggling right now? I really don't know.

Name: D_6
dialogue: I really don't know what to do next. My dream of making it big as the developer of Nyra and other software was just not it. Luck didn't sway in my direction as I had hoped.

Name: D_8
dialogue: I will have to come up with some sort of plan tomorrow, I guess.
